title: Save is blocked for a blank, short or taken new matrix name
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click New Matrix.
  3. Type 50 in Default's first range.
  4. Click Create Matrix.
  5. Type ab in the name.
  6. Click Create Matrix.
  7. Replace the name with matrix A's name in capitals.
  8. Click Create Matrix.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 2:

  • The New Matrix page opens with an empty name.

Step 3:

  • Default's first range reads 50.

Step 4:

  • An inline error shows under the name.
  • The page stays on New Matrix with Create Matrix showing; no matrix is created.
  • It reads "Matrix name is a required field".

Step 5:

  • The name shows ab.

Step 6:

  • An inline error shows under the name.
  • The page stays on New Matrix with Create Matrix showing; no matrix is created.

Step 7:

  • The name shows in capitals.

Step 8:

  • An inline error shows under the name.
  • The page stays on New Matrix with Create Matrix showing; no matrix is created.
